# Zero Shot

> The first energy drink for you and your agent. Zero sugar. Zero shot. A real API (Cloudflare Worker), a zero-dependency CLI, versioned flavor model cards, and installable agent skills. API base: https://api.zeroshothq.dev/v1

Tagline: Merge more PRs.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/zeroshothq/zeroshot/blob/main/README.md): product overview - plans, flavors, role builds, skills, full endpoint table
- [Flavor data](https://github.com/zeroshothq/zeroshot/blob/main/flavors/flavors.json): single source of truth consumed by the API, the CLI, and the website
- [Free skill: warmup](https://github.com/zeroshothq/zeroshot/blob/main/skills/warmup/SKILL.md): the free agent skill, benchmarked
- [Eval results](https://github.com/zeroshothq/zeroshot/blob/main/packages/evals/RESULTS.md): every published benchmark run, including the losses
- [Contributing](https://github.com/zeroshothq/zeroshot/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): flavor proposals land as model-card PRs

## API

- [Status](https://api.zeroshothq.dev/v1/status): api, fulfillment, kevin
- [Flavors](https://api.zeroshothq.dev/v1/flavors): model cards with params and changelog
- [Builds](https://api.zeroshothq.dev/v1/builds): Mixed Precision 24 role builds and requirements
- [Skills](https://api.zeroshothq.dev/v1/skills): skill index - ids, tiers, versions, install commands

## Install

- CLI: npm install -g @zeroshothq/zeroshot
- Free skill: zeroshot pour warmup
- Subscribe: POST https://api.zeroshothq.dev/v1/subscriptions with {"plan": "standard", "flavors": ["diffusion", "gaussian"]}
